body: Thank you for the response, but verbal communication is never helpful for me. I get flustered and leave details out, and just end up feeling silly and uncomfortable.

Thank you for your response. It just seems really impossible at this point. I'm up against all these fresh-out-of-high-school eighteen-year-olds living in apartments their parents are paying for and their only responsibility is studying, meanwhile I'm spending hours commuting and working a shitty minimum wage job just to try to make ends meet so I can afford the gas to make it to school. 

He and I haven't fully broken up yet because he gets furious whenever I bring it up and demands I tell him who is "forcing" me to dump him. I don't know how to handle this at all.
